verdict.rationale: Qodo documents natural-language chat directly inside pull requests, and users can discuss findings or ask Qodo to apply fixes. Its Agentic Toolbox exposes review and codebase-understanding skills to conversational coding agents (Claude, Codex, Kiro) via plugins, the CLI and MCP, so users can drive core review workflows by talking to an agent. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which commands or actions the PR chat supports, natural-language control of configuration and governance (these are done through the portal or .pr_agent.toml), and independent hands-on corroboration of the chat experience.
